Class InputHandler

java.lang.Object
gamemode.gym.input.InputHandler
public class InputHandler extends Object
Utility class for registering keyboard input handlers on a JavaFX Scene.

Maps specific key presses to game actions via Runnable callbacks, keeping input binding decoupled from game logic.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public static void setup(javafx.scene.Scene scene, Runnable lane0, Runnable lane1, Runnable escapeAction)
      Registers key press handlers on the given scene.

      Key bindings:

      • D — triggers the lane 0 action
      • F — triggers the lane 1 action
      • ESC — triggers the escape action
      Parameters:
      scene - the Scene to attach the key handler to
      lane0 - the action to run when D is pressed
      lane1 - the action to run when F is pressed
      escapeAction - the action to run when ESC is pressed
